model: CompactSmoke WSC 3xx / Comfort WCC 3xx NVE control panels
equipment_type: Natural ventilation and smoke vent window controller
applies_to: WindowMaster CompactSmoke WSC 3xx smoke control panels and WCC 3xx comfort panels with NV Embedded, up to 10 motor lines.
summary: WindowMaster window-actuator control panels for smoke venting and natural ventilation, on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP. Objects cover motor groups and lines (position commands, actual positions, close commands and status), smoke zones, up to 10 NV (natural ventilation) controllers with their room values and setpoints, mechanical ventilation and heating links, a weather station and sun controllers. Most objects come in ranges of 2, 8 or 10 instances.
notes: The PICS lists objects as ranges (for example AO 1..10 Max_position_motor_group_1..10). Only the first object of each range is listed here; the description gives the range. Instance n of a range ends in _n (motor line S1 X1-X2, S2 X1-X8, groups/zones/NV controllers 1-10).
Total objects in the PICS: 669 across all ranges. NV_Comfort_status is printed as AI 91..101, which overlaps NV_Ventilation_status (AI 82..91); it is shown here starting at AI 92.
Objects for a missing motor module show Out Of Service.
The 10 Bit String Value ranges (BS 1-31) are listed as type Other; their bit meanings are in the PICS.
Several binary objects print the active/inactive texts in the opposite order to the others (marked 'as printed').
Access blank in the PICS was taken from the property table: AV writable, BO commandable, BI read-only.

source.title: WSC 3xx PICS - Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement (PICS WxC 3xx 2.0)

integration.summary: Set the device ID, UDP port or MS/TP baud rate and Max_Master on the panel touchscreen. Command window positions per motor group with the AO position objects, read back actual positions and alarms, and feed weather or room values to the NV controllers through the AV objects.

minimum_points.why: All windows on line S1 X1 closed

integration.remote_sensors: Wind speed and direction (AV 41-44) and per-NV-controller room temperature, CO2, humidity and outdoor temperature (AV 46-105) can be written from the BMS.
setup: Device ID, UDP port, MS/TP baud rate (9600-115200) and Max_Master are set on the panel LCD.
Commandable objects use a 16-level priority array.
gotchas: Objects for motor lines without a fitted motor module report Out Of Service.
